prompt: I need to create a Hebrew Word document for a university assignment summary. It should have: a title 'סיכום עבודה סמינריונית', an intro paragraph in Hebrew (2-3 sentences), a section heading 'ממצאים עיקריים', 3 Hebrew bullet points, and a closing paragraph. Please write and run a Python script to generate this as assignment_summary.docx. Make sure it will render correctly in Microsoft Word (not just LibreOffice).

assertions.description: A .docx file is saved to the output directory
Solution uses Python + zipfile approach (not npm docx library)
styles.xml defines a Normal style with w:styleId='Normal' and <w:bidi/>
document.xml contains Hebrew characters (Unicode range U+0590-U+05FF)
